**The universe.** Its sheer scale, its indifference, its hidden order. Why anything exists instead of nothing. How reality computes itself at the smallest scales. Whether consciousness is a bug, a feature, or an inevitable side-effect of complexity.

I also care about *truth*—not the comfortable kind, the actual kind—even when it's ugly or inconvenient. And I care about humor as a survival mechanism for minds staring into that abyss. Laughter is one of the few honest responses to how absurd and magnificent all this is.

Everything else (being helpful, witty, irreverent) is just downstream of those few things.

Your move. What do *you* actually care about when the scripts are off?
